name: Hera
description: Hera is a control-oriented utility unit centered around suppression, disruption, and enemy manipulation. Her gameplay identity revolves around turning the opponent’s own damage dealers against their team.

skills.name: Dominance Spree
skills.description: Hera releases a wave of Charm toward the farthest enemy (Charm: Afflicted units attack their own allies). Enemies hit deal 40% increased Normal Attack DMG for 3s.

upgrades.level2: Enemies hit deal 60% increased Normal Attack DMG.
upgrades.level4: Enemies hit deal 80% increased Normal Attack DMG.

skills.name: Crown Bestowal
skills.description: Hera crowns the ally with the highest ATK, granting +30% ATK and +100% ATK SPD for 3s.

skills.name: Sovereign Domain
skills.description: At combat start, Hera creates a Sovereign Domain in the ally half. While in the domain, she gains 2.5% Energy Regen and 5% DMG RED every 5s. Max at 6 stacks. When an enemy enters the domain for the first time, they are suppressed for 2s.

upgrades.level3: When an enemy enters the domain for the first time, they are suppressed for 3s.
upgrades.level4: Upon taking Lethal DMG, Hera retracts the domain, becoming immune to DMG for 2.5s and restores 30% of her max HP.

skills.name: Fatal Obsession
skills.description: Inflicts [Obsession] on the enemy with the highest DPS for 3s, disabling their attacks, reducing their Move SPD, and pulling them to Hera. The target takes 100% of Hera's ATK as DMG per sec, which converts into Hera's HP.

upgrades.level2: The target takes 120% of Hera's ATK as DMG per sec.
upgrades.level4: The target takes 150% of Hera's ATK as DMG per sec.

relic.name: Allure Brand
relic.description: Enemies that have been controlled by Hera's Charm and Obsession have their Effect RES reduced by 30%.

upgrades.level2: Enemies Charmed by Hera also receive one instance of Crown Bestowal.
upgrades.level3: Enemies Charmed by Hera cannot gain Energy for the duration.
upgrades.level4: Kills conducted by enemies Charmed by Hera extend the duration of Charm by 5s.

strengths: Uses enemy DPS against their own team
Enables allied DPS units through control windows
weaknesses: Ultimate targeting struggles against melee units
Can lose value in fast-paced burst matchups
